title: Drift after a historical root-move opening is not reported when the workspace returns to the last accounted revision
outcome: Reasoned, untested (re-audit for w-83754500a736): when turn N's opening resolves as HistoricalRootMove, its close is not kept as the accounted baseline (engram_source_sightings.rs:473-476), but the continuity anchor advances to that close (engram_turn_continuity.rs:133-143). If the workspace then returns to the old accounted revision, the next opening compares Equal and sends no inter_turn_change, while continuity records Drifted. The store then never sees a change the host detected.
acceptance: A reproducing test first drives an opening resolved as HistoricalRootMove, then a return to the last accounted revision before the next opening, and records whether continuity reports Drifted while no inter_turn_change is sent; the test is noted on this item with its result.

If the gap reproduces, the drift reaches the store as an inter_turn_change before the next provider handoff (or is explained by a recorded design ruling), and the test shows it; if it does not reproduce, the test stays as a regression witness and the item records why.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
